read_idx3_ubyte: read an IDX3 unsigned byte image file (plain, gz, or xz) into a PyTorch tensor
read_idx2_int: read an IDX2 integer label file (plain, gz, or xz) into a PyTorch tensor
squared_distances: compute pairwise squared Euclidean distances between two sets of flattened image vectors
squared_jittered_distances: compute squared distances between image sets with spatial jitter tolerance for alignment
match_mnist_train_set: match MNIST test images to QMNIST test images using the Hungarian algorithm
